opening.argument: The video is presented as a holiday beauty haul featuring ordinary cosmetic items, alongside a clearly described promotional giveaway. The speaker identifies a partnership with Ebates and says that ten winners will receive $200 Ulta gift cards, while the listed terms state that entrants must be Ebates members and that no purchase is necessary. Entry is described as submitting a Google form. Separate disclosures identify a $10 welcome bonus as dependent on signing up and making a $25+ purchase, and explain that affiliate links may produce a creator commission when viewers purchase. These conditions are disclosed as part of sponsored promotion, with no established false claim, hidden destination, credential theft, victim loss, or failed reward delivery.
